stories.title: Thermal Grizzly launches PhaseSheet PTM Pro with improved thermal conductivity
stories.summary: Designed for CPUs, GPUs, and other components without an integrated heat spreader, the PhaseSheet PTM Pro is reusable, electrically non-conductive, and less susceptible to the pump-out effect associated with traditional thermal paste.

stories.title: AI data centers comprehensively defeated at US midterm elections

stories.title: Binance heist began with fake job interviews and a malicious Homebrew download
stories.summary: Binance has revealed how Norh Korean attackers spent months compromising systems and employees with malicious developer software and a fake recruitment process. The intrusions eventually gave hackers access to the exchange’s internal wallet signing systems, enabling the October 29 theft.
